newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end with modest gains.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end with modest gains.

text.p: Swiss shares closed with minor gains in quiet trade with insurers were among the biggest gainers on the day, drawing strength from Wednesday's news that Zurich Insurance's first half net profit rose 32.7 percent.
Zurich added seven francs, or more than two percent, to end at 339.
Many stocks were near their strike price levels ahead of the expiry of Soffex options and futures on Friday, one dealer said.
The Swiss Market Index closed 4.8 points higher at 3,694.9 for a gain of 0.13 percent.
The all-share Swiss Performance Index rose 2.87 points, or 0.12 percent, to 2,368.34.
Swiss Bank Corp was pressured by profit-taking after Wednesday's strong gains, edging down 1.50 francs to 240.
UBS bearer shares rose 10 to 1,170 on market hopes the bank may follow SBC's example and revamp its domestic business before the end of the year, a dealer said.
CS Holding lost one to finish at 122.75. Industrials were little changed.
